source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Rhizomatous perennial 30–100(–120) cm, typically pilose stems
morphology_documented.leaves: Basal leaves often pinnate with three large terminal and 2–4 small lateral leaflets, upper stem leaves reduced to three or one toothed leaflet
morphology_documented.flowers: Single 5-merous white flowers on long pedicels, petals 5–9 mm, fade yellowish, many stamens
morphology_documented.fruit: Spherical aggregate of achenes 1–2 cm across, persistent beaks/styles 4–7 mm

source_scope_note: Species-level and key-level traits distinguished; modern secondary traits stay attributed to their own sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Flora recognizes var. camporum and var. texanum, with leaflet apex and carpel metrics in key; variety must not be assigned without those characters
Although placed in Trees-Shrubs inventory, botanical growth habit is herbaceous; family routing, not habit, determines ownership
preservation: Additive research only, species JSON and photo/attribution/gallery assets unchanged
